title: Synopsys Just Solved a Bottleneck You Didn’t Even Know Existed
excerpt: Synopsys is using AI partnerships with Nvidia, AMD, Microsoft, and Intel to automate one of chip design’s biggest bottlenecks, strengthening its position at...
content_html:
Jabran Kundi

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 12:52 PM CDT 5 min read

Synopsys (SNPS) just went after the most tedious job in chip design. At the DAC conference, the company unveiled an AI agent that handles verification on its own, developed with Nvidia (NVDA). Synopsys says it reaches validated designs up to 50 times faster while improving coverage by 20%. Before a chip is manufactured, it has to be verified. Engineers test the design against every case it might face to catch flaws before they are set in silicon. It is slow, repetitive work, and it often eats up more of a project than the actual design does. Synopsys calls this coverage closure. For a long time, it has been one of the worst bottlenecks in the whole process. This is what the AI agent is expected to fix. What used to take weeks of manual effort, the new agent is meant to compress into hours. It runs the job from start to finish and traces the root cause when something breaks. 

The Nvidia agent is the headline, but it is not the only deal for Synopsys. The company launched autonomous chip design tools on Microsoft's (MSFT) Discovery platform, with AMD (AMD) already testing them for its next-generation AI chips. Early results showed debugging cycles cut by 25% to 40%. Synopsys has also expanded its work with Intel Foundry, certifying its AI-powered design tools on Intel's advanced 14A process. The same week, three of the biggest names in chips all partnered with the same supplier. That is the quiet advantage Synopsys holds. No matter who wins the AI chip race, Synopsys is part of that process from day one.

About Synopsys Stock

Founded in 1986, Synopsys delivers design intellectual property (IP) solutions to the global electronics and semiconductor industries. The company operates in two segments: Design IP and Design Automation. Its technologies are widely used in automotive, AI, data center, and consumer electronics markets. Synopsys' product portfolio includes Digital and Custom IC Design solutions, Verification solutions, FPGA design products, and AI-driven EDA solutions.

Synopsys has significantly underperformed the broader software sector over the past year. SNPS stock fell about 40% while the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGV) declined roughly 18% during the same period. Although the broader software sector faced pressure as investor interest shifted toward AI hardware and semiconductor stocks, Synopsys struggled even more.

content_html_zh:
贾布兰·昆迪

2026 年 7 月 29 日星期三中午 12:52 CDT 阅读时间 5 分钟

Synopsys（SNPS）刚刚开始从事芯片设计中最乏味的工作。 在 DAC 会议上，该公司推出了一款与 Nvidia (NVDA) 合作开发的能够自行处理验证的人工智能代理。 Synopsys 表示，它实现验证设计的速度提高了 50 倍，同时覆盖率提高了 20%。 在制造芯片之前，必须对其进行验证。 工程师会针对设计可能面临的每种情况进行测试，以发现缺陷，然后再将其装入硅片中。 这是一项缓慢且重复的工作，而且它占用的项目时间往往比实际设计还要多。 Synopsys 将这种情况称为覆盖范围终止。 长期以来，它一直是整个流程中最严重的瓶颈之一。 这是人工智能代理预计要解决的问题。 过去需要数周的手动工作，而新代理可以将其压缩为数小时。 它从头到尾运行作业，并在出现问题时追踪根本原因。

Nvidia 代理是头条新闻，但这并不是 Synopsys 的唯一交易。 该公司在微软 (MSFT) Discovery 平台上推出了自主芯片设计工具，AMD (AMD) 已经在其下一代人工智能芯片上测试了这些工具。 早期结果显示调试周期缩短了 25% 到 40%。 Synopsys 还扩大了与 Intel Foundry 的合作，在 Intel 先进的 14A 工艺上验证了其人工智能驱动的设计工具。 同一周，芯片领域的三大巨头都与同一家供应商合作。 这就是 Synopsys 所拥有的安静优势。 无论谁赢得人工智能芯片竞赛，新思科技从第一天起就是这一过程的一部分。

关于新思科技股票

Synopsys 成立于 1986 年，为全球电子和半导体行业提供设计知识产权 (IP) 解决方案。 该公司分为两个部门：设计IP和设计自动化。 其技术广泛应用于汽车、人工智能、数据中心和消费电子市场。 Synopsys 的产品组合包括数字和定制 IC 设计解决方案、验证解决方案、FPGA 设计产品以及人工智能驱动的 EDA 解决方案。

去年，新思科技的表现明显落后于更广泛的软件行业。 SNPS 股票下跌约 40%，而 iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGV) 同期下跌约 18%。 尽管随着投资者兴趣转向人工智能硬件和半导体股票，更广泛的软件行业面临压力，但新思科技 (Synopsys) 的处境更加艰​​难。
